record.question: Scientific name of Lima bean is
record.explanation: Defective item: the accepted scientific name of lima bean is Phaseolus lunatus (syn. P. limensis), and the printed source page (Technical Paper-II, Nov 2017, p.1, Q7) offers only Phaseolus vulgaris (common/French bean), P. coccineus (runner bean), P. lanatus (an epithet belonging to watermelon, Citrullus lanatus, not a Phaseolus) and P. aculifolius (tepary bean) - none of which is the lima bean, so no option can be defensibly chosen without repairing the question (the same paper later prints P. lunatus as an option elsewhere, confirming the name was available to the paper-setter).
